prompt:
You receive 3 images. Image 1 is the LAYOUT SKETCH of the finished 1920x1080 game screen: a crude flat-colour blocking that fixes the exact composition - camera, horizon, wall and floor lines, and the position, size and outline of every object. Repaint image 1 into a finished painting: keep every line and every block exactly where it is and exactly as large as it is, paint each block as the object described below, do not move, enlarge, shrink, add or remove anything, and leave no flat colour areas or hard geometric edges. Image 2 is a photo of the real place (geography, architecture, materials and real details to paint from; they are references only, do not copy their camera, cars, people, signs or weather). Image 3 is a finished background painting from our game: use it ONLY as the reference for the painting technique (brushwork, palette, edge softness, level of detail, line quality); do not copy anything from its scene.

Place: Rekreapark by Javorová alej in Čierna Voda (municipality Chorvátsky Grob, near Bratislava, Slovakia). Image 2 is a photo of this real park: an open timber picnic shelter on dark brown log posts with a brown wooden-shingle hip roof and a natural-stone fireplace chimney wall on its right side, standing on grey concrete paving that continues around it, a wooden playground and young trees on a wide lawn. Paint the shelter and the park from this real place; the volunteer distribution point in it is invented.

Brief: the open shelter used as a volunteer distribution point during the pandemic: distribution tables with food boxes and named paper bags, paper lists on clipboards, distancing tape on the floor, face masks and disinfectant. Thursday 29 October 2020, a sunny autumn afternoon around half past three: warm low sunlight from the left, long soft shadows falling to the right, yellow and orange autumn trees, fallen leaves.

Camera: standing on the paved forecourt, about 2.2 m high, looking straight at the long side of the open shelter, which is parallel to the picture; vertical lines stay vertical; the horizon is at y ~360. The whole shelter is in the picture. Keep this exact geometry from the sketch: the roof from its ridge at y 150 down to the dark eave at y 345-367; the four front log posts standing on the paving at y 655; the shaded shelter floor between y 600 (back posts) and y 655; the table tops at y 545; the stone fireplace wall from y 655 up to its chimney cap at y 70; the open paved forecourt from y 655 down to the bottom edge, at the same level as the shelter floor.

What the sketch blocks are: sky; the yellow and orange autumn trees of the park far behind and the lawn, seen through the open back of the shelter; a small wooden playground frame far left on the lawn; the brown wooden-shingle hip roof with its dark eave; four dark brown front log posts and three thinner back posts; the shaded paved floor under the roof; on the right the natural-stone fireplace chimney wall with a dark fireplace opening, which is the right side wall of the shelter; behind it a light gravel park path leading away between the lawn and a big orange tree; the wide grey concrete-paver forecourt along the bottom, completely empty.

Interactive props - each painted clearly inside its block, the same size as its block, easy to recognise at a glance:
1. the block of the layout sketch at x 320-620, y 475-650 of the 1920x1080 frame (17-32 % from the left, 44-60 % from the top): the left distribution table under the roof, loaded with brown paper grocery bags and a cardboard box of food, each bag with a small white name label (illegible scribbles), and a clipboard with a paper list.
2. the block of the layout sketch at x 340-610, y 688-744 of the 1920x1080 frame (18-32 % from the left, 64-69 % from the top): two bright yellow-and-black distancing tape lines stuck flat on the forecourt paving in front of the left table, one behind the other (the queue marks).
3. the block of the layout sketch at x 790-900, y 465-560 of the 1920x1080 frame (41-47 % from the left, 43-52 % from the top): on the right table a big steel thermos flask with a red cup lid and a strip of masking tape with handwriting on it (illegible), next to a box of disposable face masks and a bottle of hand sanitiser.
NPC zone at x 1285-1395, y 420-675 of the 1920x1080 frame (67-73 % from the left, 39-62 % from the top): an animated character sprite will stand here later, so paint only plain, uncluttered background in it - no person, no figure, no silhouette, no clothes on hooks that read as a person. (Ela, the volunteer coordinator, will stand there, under the roof right beside the stone fireplace wall.)
The park path behind the fireplace wall is the area of the layout sketch at x 1640-1810, y 560-690 of the 1920x1080 frame (85-94 % from the left, 52-64 % from the top).

Walkable floor: the band at x 20-1900, y 640-1040 of the 1920x1080 frame (1-99 % from the left, 59-96 % from the top) is the open grey concrete paving of the forecourt - one continuous flat surface with no kerb, no step, no edge and no change of material, and nothing standing on it: no tables, no bins, no benches, no plants, no bags, no people. Only light, long shadows, a few fallen leaves and the two tape lines described above. The paving continues out of the left edge (the area of the layout sketch at x 0-60, y 720-1020 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-3 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top)) and the right edge (the area of the layout sketch at x 1860-1920, y 720-1020 of the 1920x1080 frame (97-100 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top)).

Fiction rules: the distribution point is invented: no municipal or charity logos, no organisation names, no readable names on lists or bags - paper shows only illegible scribbles, no digits. Paint out the car and the table-tennis table of the photo. No people, no animals, no lettering anywhere.

The layout sketch is a blocking aid only: paint over all of it. Do NOT draw frames, borders, outlines or boxes around objects, and keep no flat colour block. The finished picture contains no UI, no captions, no text except what is asked for above, no watermark and no people or animals unless stated above.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
